model.name: MiniMax-Music3
model.description: MiniMax-Music3 creates complete stereo songs from lyrics and a detailed music caption, with expressive vocals, evolving arrangements, and long-form structure up to five minutes. Maestro uses WanGP's optimized ConvRot checkpoints with CUDA-graph or vLLM semantic decoding when supported.
model.selector_help: Best for full songs with detailed lyric sections and arrangement control. The default optimized download is about 15 GB. On 16 GB+ GPUs, Audio Memory Profile 3/3+ enables the accelerated CUDA-graph planner; compatible FlashAttention systems add the vLLM kernels automatically. Model weights use the MiniMax-Music3 Community License.

alt_prompt:
### Global Metadata
Warm acoustic pop at 96 BPM in C major; intimate and hopeful, growing into a wide final chorus; polished natural production.

### Vocal Details
Soft, close female lead with breathy verses, clear diction, and light stacked harmonies in the chorus.

### Arrangement
Fingerpicked acoustic guitar and soft piano open the song. Brushed drums and upright bass enter in the chorus; strings bloom gently before a sparse outro.
